The '''M-7 Razorwire''' was a model of [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] produced by the shipyards at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Primarily a minelayer, the Razorwire was equipped with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], seismic mines, and concussion mines as a standard payload.<ref name="GS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The M-7 Razorwire is one of the four bomber models available to Imperial players in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It costs 2,500 Fleet Requisition to unlock, and is the Imperial faction's minelayer and missile bomber, with the [[Rampart Mark Four]] as its Republic counterpart.<ref name="GS" />
